# POST /api/v1/admin/actions/runners/registration-token

Gets or creates a global actions runner registration token

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (token with AccessTokenScopeCategoryAdmin) · **ID:** `ep-113`

## Request

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — RegistrationToken

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `token` | string | Registration token string (40 char random) |

- **500** — DB error creating/fetching token

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |

| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | admin.CreateRegistrationToken | controller | Call shared.GetRegistrationToken(ctx, 0, 0) |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | shared.GetRegistrationToken | service | Call actions_model.GetLatestRunnerToken(ctx, 0, 0); If not found or inactive, call actions_model.NewRunnerToken(ctx, 0, 0); Return token string |
